data.title: Choose the correct answer for each question.
data.description: Practise advanced verb patterns where gerund and infinitive choices change meaning or follow specific constructions.
learningPoints: Use try + -ing and try + to-infinitive according to meaning.
Use allow, recommend and advise with appropriate patterns.
Recognise verbs that take object + infinitive or gerund structures.
Choose verb patterns according to both grammar and intended meaning.

sections.explain: REMEMBER + -ING refers to a memory of a past action; REMEMBER + TO means not forgetting a necessary action.

words.word: I remember meeting her for the first time.
I remember to meet her for the first time, referring to a past memory.
I remember meet her for the first time.

sections.summary: Using 'remember to do' for a future task.
sections.explain: REMEMBER + TO + verb means make sure you do something.

words.word: Remember to lock the door before you leave.
Remember locking the door before you leave, as an instruction.
Remember lock the door before you leave.

sections.explain: STOP + -ING means cease an activity; STOP + TO means pause one action in order to do another.

words.word: He stopped smoking last year.
He stopped to smoke last year, meaning he gave up the habit.
He stopped smoke last year.

sections.explain: STOP + TO + verb means pause what you are doing in order to do something else.

words.word: We stopped to have a coffee on the way home.
We stopped having a coffee on the way home, meaning we paused the journey for coffee.
We stopped have a coffee on the way home.

sections.explain: TRY + -ING means test a possible solution.

words.word: If the screen freezes, try restarting the computer.
If the screen freezes, try to restart the computer, meaning test this as one possible solution.
If the screen freezes, try restart the computer.

sections.explain: TRY + TO + verb means make an effort to do something, whether or not it succeeds.

words.word: I tried to open the window, but it was stuck.
I tried opening the window, but it was stuck, with the focus on unsuccessful effort rather than experimenting.
I tried open the window, but it was stuck.

sections.explain: ALLOW can take object + TO + infinitive.

words.word: The new system allows users to change their settings.
The new system allows users changing their settings.
The new system allows to users change their settings.

sections.explain: RECOMMEND is commonly followed by -ING when no object is stated.

words.word: I recommend booking in advance.
I recommend to book in advance.
I recommend book in advance.

sections.explain: ADVISE can take object + TO + infinitive.

words.word: The doctor advised him to reduce his workload.
The doctor advised him reducing his workload.
The doctor advised to him reduce his workload.

sections.explain: REGRET + -ING expresses regret about something already done.

words.word: I regret telling him the secret.
I regret to tell him the secret, meaning I am sorry about a past action.
I regret tell him the secret.
